# Emetos Notes

A **small** project to try the *Markdown preview* of Emetos. See [the guide](docs/guide.md) or the
[website](https://example.com/emetos).

![A banner](docs/banner.png)

## What is in it

- headings, paragraphs and `inline code`
- lists with ~~old~~ new items
  - and nested ones
- [x] a task that is done
- [ ] a task that is not

1. first step
2. second step

> A block quote with a *note* in it.

## Usage

| Command | What it does | Default |
|:--------|:------------:|--------:|
| `run`   | starts it    | `yes`   |
| `stop`  | stops it     | `no`    |

```go
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello") // greets
}
```
